_comment: SOLE signer-verifier allowlist for asymmetric (Ed25519) capability leases — Foundation C rev4 (ASYMMETRIC-LEASE-AUTHORITY-DESIGN-20260806.md). Public-only; NO private material. Consumers (C2 issuer, C2 enforcement) verify signed leases against this file via capability_lease.verify_authoritative(). key_id is a REQUIRED signed field on every ed25519 lease; a key entry not present here, or present with status != "active", denies at verify time (re-checked every call). ACTIVATION (2026-08-06): key lease-signer-2026-08 is now paired with a SOPS-provisioned private key held ONLY by the confined aq-lease-signing-authority service (/run/secrets/lease-signing-ed25519-private-key, 0400). Phase 1 of activation: service enabled, but CAPABILITY_ASYMMETRIC_LEASE still 0 (gate keeps HMAC) — flip to 1 is Phase 2.
